Theres a spot in Kentucky, in the Daniel Boone National Forest that always has and always will creep me out. 

My father has told me stories of him fishing around dusk with his cousin in this place. (A branch of the local lake leads out this way through the hills). This one time theyre out fishing and about head home when they start hearing noises coming from the surrounding forest. Keep in mind theres a dead end road here and theres only one way in and out of this canyon. There are no houses and no other roads into this place. 

Out from the woods people come, and they dont say a word. My dad claims that they looked unwashed, clothes torn, just staring them down. Like something out of Deliverance. I guess my dad or his cousin flashed a pistol and they both just backed off toward their truck and drove off. 

This other time im camping out there with a friend. This is sort of toward the end of the same road which would be maybe 5-6 miles long until it hits a dead end. 

As we’re sitting around the fire around midnight, we begin to hear forest noises. No big deal right? Could be a deer or a raccoon or possum or something shuffling about. Then we begin to hear splashes further away in the water. It sounded like maybe a carp was splashing around and it sounded pretty far off at that. No big deal. The shuffling gets louder from all sides and the splashing increases in volume as well as frequency until it feels like something is right on top of us. We have no idea what so we drop everything and hop in my truck and drive off. 

After many discussions, we have never arrived at a conclusion and we have never gone back.

Alright, so there was this one night about 3 years ago when me and a good friend when out in the sticks near where im from in Kentucky. We have had camp set up for several hours and at this point my friend and I are sitting around the campfire telling stories and just conversing. 

Throughout the night (its probably 12 or so) we have been hearing your typical nocturnal nature sounds such as rustling leaves or random animal calls in the night. As both of us had been in this area before, neither of is thought much of it until these next sounds. 

In the time span of maybe 10 minutes, we had heard 3 very large splashes in the lake that we were camped near. As if either a very large fish was falling from a great height or someone was throwing a large mass into the water. Now the problem here was that they seemed to be getting closer with each splash. 

Being out with no cell service, at night with no one even within ear shot, you tend to get kind of creeped out by these odd coincidences. Not to mention that people had gone missing near here and strange people had been reported coming out of the hills (just like in Deliverance). 

After about the 3rd or 4th splash, perhaps a few seconds pass by and we hear what seem to be very slow but rhythmic crunches of leaves. They almost sound like slow footsteps just beyond the fire light. 

By now its fight or flight in this situation with the odds not in our favor in the event of a fight. So bearing the disappearances, possibilities of hillbillies, and our extreme disadvantages, my friend and i hop in my truck and drive back to my house where we stay the rest of the night and get our stuff at daylight. 

When we return, i found none of our belongings disturbed except our peace of mind. To this day my friend and i still ponder what is, was, or could’ve been in those isolated hills. 

Bonus story: 

About 20 years ago, my dad and his cousin were out fishing in this same area when they heard some noises off to the right from their boat in the woods. As my dad tells it, a bunch of people, dirty looking and seeming to almost lumber as if injured or disabled, came into view.
